Product Overview
This elegant and sophisticated A-line dress features a high-waisted slim fit design, combining fashionable floral prints with splicing craftsmanship to perfectly highlight feminine charm. The round neck and short sleeve design offer comfort and breathability, making it suitable for various occasions such as leisure, commuting, beach outings, and daily wear.
